## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 422 captures during January 2025. This represents the activity reported for the site during the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes. All results described below relate to the 422 captures recorded at Harbour Eye Clinic in January 2025.

## Image quality

A total of 30 captures were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 7.1 per cent. These captures could not be used for grading and should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate operational process.

## Grading

Grading identified 102 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 9 days. This provides the reported measure of turnaround for the month and should be considered alongside the activity volume, the number of ungradable captures and the referable results. The findings support continued monitoring of image quality, grading activity and turnaround at Harbour Eye Clinic.
